name: Preparation Servant
background: Preparing the upper room for the Passover meal, aware of the Master's impending departure.

genericReactions.physical: The cup was broken. It seemed like a bad omen.
genericReactions.testimonial: I heard them arguing, but quietly. Something about who was the greatest.
genericReactions.digital: I just prepare the room. I don't read the scrolls.
genericReactions.environmental: The air in that room was so heavy. You could feel something was about to happen.
genericReactions.analytical: Thirteen men at the table. One of them left early.
genericReactions.prophecy: He spoke of his body and blood. It was strange, and sad.
